about: Witnesses of the Maxwell chain (rabbitsoftware.io/maxwell). Each one downloads the public chain, re-checks every hash, link and work target, and signs the head it verified. A head counts as independently checked when k different registered witnesses have signed it. To be listed, open a pull request that adds your public key and the https address of your published cosignature file. See docs/peer-review.md.

witnesses.name: pc-witness
witnesses.note: The owner's PC; signs only if both the JavaScript witness and the Python verifier pass.

witnesses.name: cloud-witness
witnesses.note: Google Cloud Run job with its own key in Secret Manager; runs every 6 hours.
